provided.title: File:Early morning street view in Nairobi, Kenya.jpg

observed.caption: A person walks down the center of a narrow urban street lined with parked vans and multi-story buildings at dawn.
observed.description: A paved street stretches into the distance between multi-story buildings on both sides, with a white Nissan pickup parked on the left curb near a discarded tire and a row of white and silver vans parked along the right curb. A single person wearing dark pants, a dark and light jacket, and white shoes walks toward the camera in the center of the road. Shopfronts and street lights are illuminated along both sides, with visible signs on building facades, and a tall building under construction is visible in the background under an overcast gray sky. The road surface is worn with scattered debris and faint lane markings.
